software.name: Python
software.role: Standard library only; one inherited exact frequency-map helper is imported

mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite Weyl/metaplectic/Fourier phases and twirl characters; actual-symbol support and full-band alias isolation; rational gap constants and an independent cyclic resolvent control; two ensembles with identical quadratic channel and different nonlinear rank-one functional/fourth-power moments; common-noise commutator and swap identities; constructive traceless Weyl Lie generation.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z/(2N) integer phases, exact Z cyclotomic polynomial arithmetic, Fraction rational numbers and rational real/imaginary pairs Q(i); no floating arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: Odd N>=3; integer-label ordinary W_N(a,b)=(-1)^(ab) T_N(a,b) with alias phases retained; S=[[3,4],[2,3]], F_xy=exp(2pi i xy/N)/sqrt(N); normalized one-copy and two-copy Hilbert-Schmidt norms; actual raw-symbol coordinates (k,ell) correspond to ordinary labels (ell,k).

bounds.weyl_labels: Every pair of centered labels, with four additional adversarial wrapped first labels, and every coordinate entry
bounds.twirl_labels: All centered labels at all odd N=3..13, including composite N=9
bounds.fourier_fourth_powers: Every residue label at all odd N=3..33
bounds.lie_generation: Every nonzero residue label at each stated dimension; nonzero modular commutator coefficient and constructive reachability

non_claims: No finite check proves the asymptotic growing-band estimate, the singular gap, effective constants or a uniform two-copy rate
No full nonlinear determinant integral, actual large-N spectrum, Gaussian sample, stochastic path, original-map noise removal or BGS limit is computed
Finite residue-generation controls do not replace the general O29 Lie and commutant proof; no analytic Lean or world-priority certificate
